_about: Vibration severity zones, RMS velocity in mm/s over 10-1000 Hz.
bounds = A/B, B/C, C/D and the top of zone D. The standards stop at C/D;
the fourth number is 2.5 x C/D, where the engine reports FAILED.
An accelerometer is integrated to velocity by the engine, so every class
ISO 10816-7 (rotodynamic pumps) is not included: its tables could not be
checked against a published source, and a limit nobody can check is worse
than none. ISO 10816-1 class III is the stand-in for P-101.
